note: Speakers are role labels. Diarisation and transcription are upstream of this file; it arrives already labelled.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Week one of the four-week window. Same order as always, and I want a date attached to anything you tell me is being handled.

lines.speaker: Platform lead
lines.text: Platform is fine. The v2 interface contract is drafted, it is out for internal review, and I have it down to publish on the twenty-fourth.

lines.speaker: Integration lead
lines.text: That date matters to us. Field mapping is sitting on the contract and we cannot finalise until it is published.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Are you stopped, or are you slowed?

lines.speaker: Integration lead
lines.text: Slowed. We are working against stubs. If the twenty-fourth moves we stop, because there is nothing else on that path.

lines.speaker: Platform lead
lines.text: It will not move. I own it and the review comments are minor.

lines.speaker: Data migration lead
lines.text: First dry run is done. It failed referential integrity on two of the account tables, and we are working the fixes now.

lines.speaker: Data migration lead
lines.text: The rollback rehearsal has not happened. It is on the plan, nobody is against it, but I have not put a name against it yet.

lines.speaker: Programme architect
lines.text: The rehearsal has to land before the cutover window opens or we are migrating without a way back.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Owner and date on the rehearsal, please. Not this week, but before the end of the window.

lines.speaker: Test lead
lines.text: Environment provisioning for the integration test environment is behind. The request went in, it has not been actioned.

lines.speaker: Test lead
lines.text: I think we will get it. Probably by the end of the month, all being well.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: And if it is not there by the end of the month?

lines.speaker: Test lead
lines.text: Then the integration milestone moves, and integration and data migration both have to replan around it.

lines.speaker: Reporting lead
lines.text: Reporting is steady. We closed the legacy extract job and the nightly refresh window this week.

lines.speaker: Reporting lead
lines.text: New requests are coming in from the finance side but nothing I would raise yet.

lines.speaker: Adoption lead
lines.text: The user guide is drafting. The go-live pack has not started and I do not have a date for it.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Who owns the go-live pack?

lines.speaker: Adoption lead
lines.text: Me. No date yet. Realistically it depends on when training needs analysis closes.

lines.speaker: Test lead
lines.text: One more from us. The end-to-end scenario that uses migrated data is blocked on the rollback rehearsal ticket, so it is sitting still.

lines.speaker: Programme architect
lines.text: On the contract, I would say publishing it is the single highest-value thing on the programme right now. Two workstreams are downstream of it.

lines.speaker: Platform lead
lines.text: Understood. Twenty-fourth.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Anything anyone has not said that they should have?

lines.speaker: Data migration lead
lines.text: The reconciliation report has not been picked up. It is open and nobody has touched it.

lines.speaker: Adoption lead
lines.text: Training needs analysis has been open since the end of June. I have not moved it.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Noted. Board goes out this afternoon. Same time next week.
